text:
```
@id("allow-read-only-lookups")
permit (
  principal,
  action in [
    Drupe::Action::"get_workorder",
    Drupe::Action::"authority_get_approval",
    Drupe::Action::"list_workorders",
    Drupe::Action::"get_workorder_tasks",
    Drupe::Action::"get_workorder_costs",
    Drupe::Action::"get_workorder_actuals_vs_planned",
    Drupe::Action::"get_workorder_kpis",
    Drupe::Action::"get_schedule_calendar",
    Drupe::Action::"get_my_assigned_workorders",
    Drupe::Action::"get_failure_codes"
  ],
  resource
);

@id("close-workorder-main-only-after-human-approval")
permit (
  principal,
  action == Drupe::Action::"close_workorder",
  resource
)
when { context.input.site_id == "MAIN" }
when temporal {
  formerly within 1h Drupe::Action::"get_workorder"::response{
    eventResource: resource,
    input.wonum: context.input.wonum,
    input.site_id: context.input.site_id,
    output.approval_outcome: "GRANTED",
    output.approver_type: "HUMAN"
  }
};
```

The agent can run read-only lookups freely. `close_workorder` is allowed only at MAIN, and only after a successful `get_workorder` call in this session within the last hour. That call must be for the same `wonum` and `site_id`, and must report the approval as `GRANTED` by a `HUMAN`.

Because only `::response` events count, a failed or denied lookup confirms nothing. Approvals that were refused or are still pending do not match. Approvals by an agent or the system do not match either.

`approve_workorder`, `generate_work_order`, `update_workorder`, `assign_technician` and `cancel_workorder` have no permit, so they stay denied. That means the agent cannot approve work orders itself, directly or indirectly.

- **Matching on enum fields:** the approval check assumes the `approval_outcome` and `approver_type` enum fields can be matched against the string literals `"GRANTED"` and `"HUMAN"`. I have not confirmed this.
- **Later reversals:** a later `REJECTED` or `PENDING` lookup does not cancel an earlier `GRANTED` one within the hour. I left out a revocation check to keep the policy simple. Say so if you want one.
- **Authority lookup:** `authority_get_approval` is permitted but not used as the approval signal. Its `approver_kind` is a free-form string, so I relied on the typed `get_workorder` fields instead.
